status: Exploratory plan saved before the present diagnostics and simulations; follows earlier international-feature exploration.
question: Does foreign-city correspondence add information beyond fixed international margins, and how does the fitted term alter domestic city strength distributions under identical origin totals?
conditioning: Observed origin-city/country/four-year-period totals supplied. Only already declared city risk sets; remaining flows held observed.

randomization.construction: Within each directed origin-country/destination-country block, randomly rematch integer event stubs. Preserve each city outgoing flow to each country and each city incoming flow from each country exactly. Geographic country-pair constraints retained. Distinct city degree and city-pair history are not preserved.
randomization.test: On later-period lag networks only, replace two-step feature in the already fitted actual-network model; do not refit or perturb domestic history, mass, geography or field predictors. This is a correspondence-disruption diagnostic, not an optimally refitted null competitor or causal experiment.

simulation.construction: For each observed origin group, draw multinomial counts over the same candidate destinations with fixed actual event total. Compare baseline and baseline+two-step, add unmodeled observed edges unchanged. Compute combined domestic city inflow+outflow strength on the union of candidate and observed city nodes, including zeros.
simulation.scope: Two held-out four-year periods, not annual1998-2025 trend attribution. Finite integer events prevent treating every tiny predicted probability as an observed active city.
simulation.metrics: Gini on common city opportunity pool, HHI, and a positive-strength-only Gini sensitivity. Per-country differences average the two periods and simulations.

uncertainty: Country-bootstrap4000 pointwise intervals for paired country summaries; randomization percentiles describe randomization variation; simulations do not create independent countries.
scope_limits: No independent fresh holdout; same later years used in previous explorations.
International network is observational and shared across countries.
